name: Image Slider Pro – Responsive Slider & Carousel
author: Bokhtyer Abid

sections.description:
Image Slider Pro is a fast, mobile-friendly image slider and carousel plugin for WordPress. Build a hero slider, testimonial slider, product slider, banner or card carousel without writing code: add slides, drag headings, text, buttons and images on top of them, set different positions for desktop, tablet and mobile, and give every element its own animation.

Start from one of the 10 ready-made template sliders (six hero banners, testimonials, product showcase, promo banner, cards carousel), or build your own from scratch. Works with the block editor, widgets, shortcodes and theme templates. Compatible with WooCommerce products and any custom post type.

Builder

  • Drag & drop slides and layers (heading, text, button, image)
  • Per-layer design: font, size, line height, letter spacing, case, italic, underline, text shadow, colour, background, border, radius, shadow, opacity
  • Desktop / Tablet / Mobile preview with per-device position, width, font size and visibility
  • Slide backgrounds: colour, gradient, overlay, focal point, separate mobile image
  • Live preview: a fully working preview of the unsaved slider at desktop, tablet and mobile width (slide, hover, click, animations, video and lightbox all work)
  • Undo / redo, local draft recovery, keyboard shortcuts
  • 10 ready-made template sliders with a live preview: six hero banners (classic, centered, dark, bold, app launch, event), testimonials, product showcase, promo banner, cards carousel
  • Ready-made slide layouts you can add inside the builder

Animation

  • Entrance animation for every element, with delay and duration, replayed each time a slide appears
  • Slide transitions: slide, fade, zoom, flip
  • Ken Burns zoom on the active image
  • Respects the visitor’s “reduce motion” setting

Slider options

  • Slides per view with tablet and mobile breakpoints, autoplay, loop, drag, RTL, auto height, fixed height
  • Arrow styles, dot styles (circles, squares, lines, numbers), colours, sizes and positions, look presets
  • Thumbnail navigation
  • Lightbox
  • Video slides: YouTube, Vimeo or your own file (YouTube and Vimeo load only after the visitor clicks play)
  • Post-based sliders: latest posts, a category, or WooCommerce products, using a template slide
  • Custom CSS class and custom CSS per slider
  • Export and import sliders as JSON

Use it anywhere

  • Shortcode, Gutenberg block, widget, or image_slider_render() in theme templates

Accessibility

  • Labelled arrows, dots and slides; hidden slides are removed from the tab order
  • Pause button for autoplay; autoplay waits while the slider has keyboard focus; arrow keys move the slider
  • Visible keyboard focus and a keyboard-operable lightbox

Usage

  1. Go to Image Slider > Templates and click “Use this template”, or go to Image Slider > Builder Sliders > Add New to start from scratch.
  2. Change the text and images, then publish.
  3. Copy the shortcode shown on the slider screen into a page.
    Example shortcode: [image_slider slider="12"]

Other ways to show a slider:

  • Block editor: add the Image Slider block and pick a slider.
  • Widget: Image Slider Pro under Appearance > Widgets.
  • Theme templates: image_slider_render( array( 'slider' => 12 ) );

Sliders made with the older version of the plugin (slides and groups) keep showing on your site:

  • [image_slider] shows all slides, [image_slider group="home"] shows one group.
  • The old “All Sliders”, “Add New Slider” and “Slider Groups” screens are gone. Old slides can no longer be added or edited; make a new slider with the builder and use its shortcode instead. Nothing is deleted.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin to /wp-content/plugins/image-slider-pro/, or install it from the Plugins screen.
  2. Activate it through the Plugins screen.
  3. Open Image Slider in the admin menu.
sections.faq:
Do my old sliders still work?

Yes. [image_slider] and [image_slider group="..."] keep showing the old slides on your pages, and the old slides are not deleted. The old screens for adding and editing slides and groups are removed, so to change a slider, build a new one under Image Slider > Builder Sliders and replace the old shortcode with the new one.

Does the plugin delete my sliders when I uninstall it?

No. Only the plugin’s own housekeeping data is removed. Your sliders, slides and groups are kept.

Does it load anything from YouTube or Vimeo by itself?

No. A video slide shows an image with a play button; the video is loaded only after the visitor clicks it.

How do I move a slider to another site?

Export it from the Builder Sliders list, then import the file on the other site. Tick “Download the slider images” when importing so the images are copied too.
sections.changelog:
2.0.0

  • New: 10 ready-made template sliders with a full working preview (Image Slider > Templates)
  • New: live preview tab in the builder, and a Preview link on every slider and group
  • New: drag & drop slider builder with layers, per-device settings and a live canvas
  • New: animations for every element, slide transitions, Ken Burns
  • New: groups, per-group settings, arrow and dot styles, look presets, custom CSS
  • New: thumbnails, lightbox, video slides, post-based sliders
  • New: Gutenberg block, widget, image_slider_render(), export and import
  • New: accessibility improvements (labels, pause button, focus handling)
  • Improved: the shortcode now returns its output instead of printing it, and assets load only on pages that use a slider
  • Changed: slides are no longer public pages of their own (no archive or single URL)
  • Changed: the old “All Sliders”, “Add New Slider” and “Slider Groups” screens are removed from the admin. Existing old slides and groups still show on the site through their shortcodes, but new sliders are made with the builder
  • Improved: builder screens redesigned (tabs, settings cards with one section at a time, toggle switches, accordion for layer options)
  • Improved: the builder Preview opens in a modal, like the Templates page
  • New: line height, letter spacing, letter case, italic, underline and text shadow for text layers
  • New: custom CSS class and custom CSS for every element
  • New: gradient overlay on slide backgrounds
  • New: hover colours for buttons (background, text and border)
  • New: upload your own arrow images (previous / next) for the slider arrows; they are included in export and import
  • New: “Reset section” link on every settings section
  • Improved: the slider, the editor canvas and the preview change height smoothly
  • Improved: each element in the builder opens its own options in place; “Slide background” is always in the list
  • Fixed: the builder Preview tab was blank
  • Fixed: big headings with two lines overlapped in the template thumbnails and in themes that give the page a fixed line height; text layers now have their own line height
  • Improved: the Templates page has a new card design (hover preview, slide count, effect and autoplay tags)
  • Improved: the 10 template sliders are re-designed: clean sans-serif type, tighter letter spacing, even spacing between elements on desktop, tablet and phone, button shadows and hover colours
  • Fixed: slide images could look stretched on themes without a “height:auto” image rule (seen in the builder Preview at mobile width)
  • Changed: requires WordPress 6.5 and PHP 8.0

1.0.2

  • Previous release.
